text_block_list.name: Recap
text_block_list.text:
Previously on Kiseki's Journey!
After suffering defeat against tough
rivals,
Kiseki secures a rematch to challenge them
once more in a mock race!

text_block_list.name: Recap
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki swore to craft an exciting race this
time and seize victory!
And what's this?!
Three whole Trainers have stepped up to
offer their aid!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki,
your drive is truly remarkable.
But your form and acceleration
are lacking basic fundamentals.
Let's fix that! You've got huge potential!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and run freely!
I'll protect your passion and creativity!
That independent spirit is your greatest
weapon!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Trainer,
doesn't this feel like a training arc?!
I feel like my power level just shot up by
at least 50,000!

While Kiseki is thrilled by the turn of
events,
as a Trainer myself,
my feelings are far more complicated.
choice_data_list: (This is a "battle" between Trainers.)

text_block_list.text:
Can I prove that I am the one who can guide
this
fascinating horsegirl toward her dream and
earn her contract?
choice_data_list: (I never thought things would turn...

text_block_list.text:
Still, since I fell for her running,
I can't afford to lose either.
choice_data_list: I'm going to face her head-on with...
I have to face her head-on with ev...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Here's my next new special move!
The "Centrifugal Evader"!!
When entering a corner,
grab the inner rail and whip right around!
choice_data_list: Mmh, I see!

text_block_list.text:
Touching the inner rail is completely out
of the question safety- and rule-wise.
However,
focusing on cornering is an intriguing
perspective. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...What made you think of that idea?
...What made you think of that idea?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in a car racing manga!
It said cornering speed
is just as crucial as straightaway top speed
in a race! So—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Oh,
right! If I can't secure a spot
along the inner rail,
this strategy is totally useless.
Scrapped!
choice_data_list: Wait, I didn't mean we should just...

text_block_list.text:
I urge her to pause before jumping to such
a hasty conclusion. Perhaps because
she comes up with ideas in rapid succession,
she has no hesitation tossing them aside.
choice_data_list: (But if we want to make the plan e...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...? You seem a bit hesitant today,
Trainer.
And you've had your arms crossed the entire
time...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I really want to engage with...
Yeah, I really want to engage with...

text_block_list.text:
Something has been lingering in my mind.
If she wants to settle it with a final burst
of speed like last time,
it would be natural to focus on straightaway
top speed, not cornering.

Yet she didn't do that.
There must have been a reason behind it.
If she isn't consciously aware of it...
I'll help put it into words and give shape
to her intuition.
choice_data_list: Try expanding that idea into an al...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? An alternative plan...?
Hmm... Uhhh, well...!?
choice_data_list: I know you can come up with an eve...
I know you can come up with an eve...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Focus up, Kiseki!
Neglect the basics,
and your late burst is as good as useless!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah—yes, sir! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Other Trainers give clear,
concrete instructions.
Detailed enough that I don't even have to
think for myself... But *they*...)

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I want my runners to race freely and follow
their instincts.
That's why I don't micromanage.
You're the one who needs to think, Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(See?!
There are plenty of people who'd just leave
me be without interfering!
You were just a reader before...!
So why do I keep—)

“I know you can come up with something way
more interesting.”

“I know you can come up with something way
more interesting.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............
...Ghhhh, GAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just how much are you expecting from me,
anyway?!

That night,
Kiseki sent over a massive 48-page manga
storyboard.
It seemed she had used manga as a canvas to
map out her race concept.
choice_data_list: Put this on hold, scrap that one...
Put this on hold, scrap that one...

text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since I resolved to
face her head-on.
Frankly, things are so tense right now,
it wouldn't surprise me if she dumped me on
the spot.

Kiseki has the soul of an artist.
She wants to pour herself into her craft
without friction.
Being forced into creative gridlock is the
last thing she needs.
choice_data_list: Even so... I want to see this through.

text_block_list.text:
...I want her to wrestle with her creative
vision until she's completely satisfied.
I'll do whatever it takes to support that—
even if she comes to hate me for it—
choice_data_list: Because you're capable of creating...
Because you're capable of creating...

text_block_list.text:
(*pitter-patter,
pitter-patter... WHOOSH!*)

The weekend.
I step outside to pick up some new reference
materials for Kiseki,
only to get completely stranded by a sudden
downpour.

Worse, the rain keeps intensifying.
So much for waiting it out...
To top it off,
the train lines seem to be delayed across
the board.
choice_data_list: (Man, this is bad... Hm?)

text_block_list.text:
A chime rings on my smartphone.
It's a message from Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Where are you?
The lights were on in the office.”
choice_data_list: “I'm actually out, stranded by the...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “Ah! Got it!”

After waiting around for dozens of minutes...
I suddenly hear the sound of someone sprinting
full tilt through the storm.
What brave soul could possibly be running
in this weather—?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: FOUND YOUUUUU, TRAIIINEEEER!!
choice_data_list: Wh-What?! Kiseki?!

text_block_list.text:
She tears through the driving rain,
paying no heed to the pelting downpour.
Wait,
she just said she was at the Trainer's office,
which means—
choice_data_list: You ran all the way from the academy?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*pant... pant... whew...*
...HERE! Take it!
choice_data_list: ‘Take it’?! Wh-What are you—
‘Take it’?! Wh-What are you—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just look at it! I need your feedback!
Inspiration struck me this morning! Gaaah,
I just couldn't wait another second!!

I drop my umbrella and research materials
to take the tablet from her.
I'm stunned.
To think she actually ran all this way...
She really has—
choice_data_list: Unbelievable stamina and guts...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well,
that's one thing I'm pretty proud of—
wait...
...............WHAAAAT?!
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.text:
“...What made you come up with that idea,
Kiseki?”
“Try developing that concept into a different
angle.”

“...What made you come up with that idea,
Kiseki?”
“Try developing that concept into a different
angle.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(—Why was I focusing so much on the corners
to begin with?
Sure,
cornering is vital for launching your final
straightaway drive, but...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Cornering isn't a technique meant *only*
for deep closers!
If my gut told me that's where my winning
shot was... then that must mean—!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer! Actually, forget it! I'm sorry!
Scratch that idea on the tablet entirely!
choice_data_list: Whaaat?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-I just had an absolute lightning bolt of
inspiration!
—Just hear me out!!
